roles.responsibility: Reconcile intent and actual evidence; never infer completion from narrative.
Choose one smallest eligible outcome. Blocked work does not occupy a writer.
Reviewer identity must differ from producer; exact revision evidence is mandatory.
Compare outcome quality, rework and effort; improve one method under existing owner scope.

ports.fresh_queue: Fresh issue body/comments plus observation time and digest; source failure blocks selection.
ports.claims: Actual exclusive scope claim, branch head, expiry/fence and writer identity; open PR alone is not activity.
ports.source_revisions: Exact immutable source/dependency commits and input hashes.
ports.prior_checkpoint: Latest durable verified checkpoint or explicit null.
ports.audit_result: Canonical task IDs and coverage delta; no second ledger.
ports.candidate_options: Benefit, effort, risk, reversibility, downstream unlock and evidence confidence with unknowns preserved.
ports.ownership: Permission ceiling distinct from current reservation; exact and glob/subtree overlaps checked.
ports.authorization: Concrete allowed action and limits, never inferred from score.
ports.candidate_revision: Exact code/input identities tested and reviewed.
ports.test_receipts: Pass/fail/not_run, nonzero counts, required suite identities and source revision.
ports.acceptance_criteria: Stable criterion IDs with proof requirements.
ports.accepted_results: Verified component vs integrated-main vs operational states kept separate.
ports.failures: Append-only failed attempts and retry lineage.
ports.measurements: Actual active time/wall time, cost and rework with unknowns null.
ports.coverage_delta: Source-backed added/changed/missing requirements; preserve unrelated obligations.

cadence.periodic_fallback: May be configured separately; this artifact makes no scheduled-run claim.
cadence.overlap: Coalesce duplicate triggers by task and input digest; one live writer per overlapping scope.
cadence.idle: No eligible delta means no-op checkpoint, not fabricated work.
cadence.staleness: Refresh queue, scope and authorization immediately before any actual write.

selection.unknown_score: Unknown ranking inputs require a bounded investigation or decision, never zero-cost defaults.
selection.tie: Deterministic task ID tie-break only among equivalent eligible options.
selection.queue_horizon: Maintain at least 25 concrete scoped next actions in the existing queue, not duplicate entries here.
selection.eligibility: Global freshness/capacity gates are necessary but insufficient: filter each candidate by its own scope/dependency/authority/input gates before ranking.

checkpoints.persistence: Spec only: runner must persist before effects and after readback; crash/restart storage is not implemented here.

recovery.matching_readback: Record confirmed once, never repeat the effect.
recovery.absent_readback: Retry only when known not executed, action still authorized and bounded budget remains.
recovery.unavailable_readback: Block and recheck later; never blind retry.
recovery.conflicting_readback: Stop, reconcile current target and seek a fresh scoped decision.

checkpoints.validation_limit: Only checkpoint shape and bounded recovery decisions are tested here, not durable persistence or stage-transition execution.

review.failed_or_missing: Return to same issue and owner; no duplicate worker.
review.post_merge: Independent current-main CI/replay is separate from component acceptance.

improvement.compare: Only comparable cycles; missing data remains null.
improvement.method_change: One hypothesis, source evidence, expected benefit, test, rollback and owner scope.
improvement.questions: Rank unresolved questions by blocking impact, uncertainty, reversibility and cost; useful answer ends in the smallest permitted next action.
improvement.promotion: A design score cannot establish runtime health or authorization.

limitations: Pure local design validation and synthetic traces do not establish durable operation.
No private schedule inventory is scored or published.
Actual freshness, leases, permissions, persistence and integration require owner implementation and real acceptance.
